questions.stem: Minutes after vaccination, an adult develops generalized urticaria, wheeze, and hypotension. Which medication should be given first?
questions.explanation: This presentation is anaphylaxis with respiratory and cardiovascular involvement. Intramuscular epinephrine is the immediate first-line treatment. Antihistamines, glucocorticoids, and bronchodilators can be adjuncts for selected symptoms but should not delay epinephrine.
